## Taylor Williams | Software Engineer Portfolio
Welcome to the repository for my personal professional portfolio. This website serves as a living document of my career journey, showcasing my technical expertise, the impact I've made in previous roles, and the technologies I use to solve complex problems.

## 🚀 About Me
I am a Lead Software Engineer specializing in building high-throughput, scalable, and reliable cloud-native applications. My focus lies at the intersection of robust backend architecture (PHP/Laravel), automated cloud infrastructure (AWS), and seamless user experiences. I thrive in environments that require architectural foresight, rigorous testing, and the ability to manage the full software development lifecycle.

## 🛠 Core Abilities
Software Architecture & Engineering
High-Throughput Systems: Designing applications capable of handling large-scale, real-time data streams and multi-tenant architectures.
API Design: Developing and optimizing RESTful APIs for seamless synchronization between core engines and interactive front-end components.
Modular Logic: Engineering reusable template layers and modular codebases to reduce development lifecycles and system overhead.
DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure
Cloud Orchestration: Managing full-stack infrastructure using AWS (Elastic Beanstalk).
CI/CD Pipeline Engineering: Implementing automated deployment pipelines using GitHub to move code from sandbox to production with zero downtime.
Infrastructure Automation: Overseeing automated deployments and multi-tier environment management.
Project Leadership & Management
Full Lifecycle Management: Leading projects from initial architectural audit through to production maintenance using Agile methodologies and tools like Monday.com.
Quality Assurance: Establishing rigorous peer review processes and automated testing environments to ensure 100% system uptime.
🏗 Project Expertise
Throughout my career, I have focused on delivering high-impact solutions across several domains:

Event-Driven Applications: Architecting large-scale digital event platforms that support massive, simultaneous user interactions and real-time data updates.
Cloud-Native Infrastructure: Building and maintaining scalable, auto-scaling environments that reduce manual intervention and operational costs.
Full-Stack Web Ecosystems: Developing comprehensive web applications that integrate complex backend logic with intuitive, responsive user interfaces.
Digital Infrastructure Management: Managing server administration, security protocols, and digital marketing ecosystems for regional-scale clients.
